purpose: Native Motus H32 Flow-SDE FSDP actor memory, likelihood replay, frozen gradients and full boundary recovery; systems benchmark only
source_inputs: 256 distinct real source observations from motor03 manifest; disjoint64 per rank, repeated8 locally for fixed-global systems benchmark
fixture_sampler: Fresh original Motus RL model, native B64 Flow-SDE with declared per-rank Torch generator and Python denoising-index seed; no ODE-addressed-noise helper
same_partition_repeat: exact logprobs and selected-step actor values, before every candidate's SGD
targets: synthetic advantages and returns around recomputed selected-step actor values; no scientific teacher GAE/value migration
native_ppo_formula: unchanged c605 loss/reduction, clip.2, valueclip.2, Huber10, actor5e-6/critic1e-4, Adam(.9,.95),eps1e-8,wd.01,gradclip1,global2048; five-epoch recipe retained, benchmark times4 scratch updates per candidate
memory_reserve: max(8GiB,8% actual device capacity), including CUDA communication; no live simulators in this actor benchmark
scratch_lineage: one fresh actor group, four updates per completed candidate plus one recovery control; candidates are successive scratch weights, never published or consumed as initialization
recovery: After first B64 four-update boundary save native DCP+optimizer and Pilot sampler/RNG/scaler/scheduler sidecars with exact input fixtures to job-local storage. Full cold readback and full local stageback precede larger candidates. Fresh process/actor group restores all owned Adam/groups/model/RNG and reproduces the next global update exactly. Raw optimizer hashes retained; only validated zero-step empty unowned entries excluded by measured native semantic layout contract.
oom_policy: stop this sweep; preserve each failed candidate and prior completed boundary. A separate restore phase may verify that boundary; never restart the failed candidate automatically.
launch_gate: Linux composition/field and exact tensor/NumPy/prompt slicing checks; verified source, fresh queue/device limits, persistent cold checkpoint mount and hot/local storage guards; actual four-GPU probe and unchanged native validate_cfg inside the allocated job
